table.name: customers
table.summary: A table containing core customer information including unique identifiers, names, registration dates, payment preferences, and VIP status.

customer_id.name: customer_id
customer_id.meaning: A unique numeric identifier assigned to each customer record.

payment_method.name: payment_method
payment_method.meaning: The preferred method used by the customer for making payments.

customer_name.name: customer_name
customer_name.meaning: The full name of the customer, potentially including titles and suffixes.

date_became_customer.name: date_became_customer
date_became_customer.meaning: The timestamp indicating when the individual first registered or was onboarded as a customer.

other_customer_details.name: other_customer_details
other_customer_details.meaning: Additional descriptive information about the customer, such as loyalty tier or special notes.
